pages.title: Measuring Distance
pages.text: Right-click a block face with the tape measure to set a start point. Walk while holding the tape to see the live readout, then click the destination to finish. Right-click in the air to switch between axis distances and total distance.
Make tape first to use in the tape measure recipe.
Each tape keeps its own starting point.

pages.title: Marker Poles
pages.text: The tape places a temporary pole if the starting face has room. Finishing the measurement removes that pole. To mark a location permanently, craft a separate marker pole and place it on a floor, wall, or ceiling.
This crafted marker stays in place until it is broken.

pages.title: Measuring Depth
pages.text: Face the edge of a drop and right-click with the plumb line. It reports the depth and surface height in the column directly ahead, including through water. Move one block at a time to sample nearby columns.
Use the plumb line where looking down is difficult.
